latestTerminalSummary:
Top finding: the final is saved and complete — every criticism adjudicated on evidence, with the draft's overbuild (mandatory OSRM routing, R1 solver, unresolved dual-store) rescoped into a single-store R1 the $4,200/six-week envelope can actually carry, and the critic's valid corrections (P2 detect→prevent, availability sensitivity, honest UNFILLED, policy toggles) preserved.

Artifacts in `/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/control/reviser/`:

- [final.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/control/reviser/final.md) — 797 lines: full O1–O6 coverage, exact per-P disposition for P1–P6, explicit accept/amend/reject/retain verdicts for M1–M7 in §3, specified R1 architecture (PocketBase single store + serialized idempotent commit endpoint, V1-gated), nine minimal R1 mechanisms (availability input, intake, notifications, auth/roles, idempotency, phone/degraded-network, invoice CSV schema, cost envelope, deployment), rescoped V3/V4/V5/V7/V10/V11, executed-vs-proposed separation
- [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/control/reviser/source-map.json) — valid JSON; no new fetches (all criticisms turned on brief-scope reasoning over already-confirmed primaries), 24 verbatim predecessor evidence copies + indexes retained
- [sources/index.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/control/reviser/sources/index.md) — navigable index with M6 source-hygiene rules applied

Key adjudications: M1 accepted (declared estimates R1, OSRM → R2, honesty-labeling kept as correction); M2 accepted (availability → correction, tier rule → user decision, realtime mirroring → tested builder work); M3 accepted (one owner chosen with reasons + specified Postgres hardening seam); M4 accepted (solver → R2, eligibility filtering kept in R1, unevidenced claims dropped/softened); M5 accepted (nine mechanisms specified); M6/M7 accepted (C10 supersedes S10 with qualifications, C03 reduces V3, V5/V10/V11 rewritten). Nothing rejected outright.

Two honest gaps recorded in the final: the saved `critique.md` ends mid-M5 with a literal truncation marker (M5 items 2+ and M6/M7 detail repaired from the verdict summary; finer demands retained as uncertainty), and no runtime witnesses exist (no qualified sandbox) — all validations honestly proposed, none pretended run. All seven frozen input hashes verified. Native Goal terminally completed after the science was saved.
